map.projection: Equirectangular, standard parallel 35 N; identical projection for outline and anchors
map.anchorSource: GeoNames.org, WGS84 city references; source URLs recorded for each anchor
map.derivation: Chengdu–Chongqing uses the mean of the two city coordinates; other clusters use a named city reference. Cluster halos and signal arcs are illustrative, not boundaries or verified connections.
map.attribution: Visible Natural Earth and GeoNames links below the map; provenance in this manifest
map.limitations: Not station coordinates, density or measured connectivity. Low-resolution geographic overview. No runtime data requests.
